name: Anti Brainrot
summary: Reclaim your YouTube focus by hiding Shorts, feeds, comments, and autoplay. Built for ADHD brains.
description:
YouTube is designed to keep you scrolling. Anti Brainrot gives you back control.

If you have ADHD, you know the trap: you open YouTube for one tutorial and surface three hours later in a Shorts spiral. The algorithm feeds on impulsivity, and willpower alone is not enough. Anti Brainrot removes the bait so you can use YouTube on your own terms.

FEATURES

- Hide the homepage feed, sidebar recommendations, and end screen suggestions
- Block Shorts, Mix playlists, and autoplay completely
- Hide comments, live chat, merch banners, and annotations
- Granular toggles -- enable only the features you need
- Collapsible feature groups for a clean popup
- 4 cozy themes (Retro Pink, Dark, Beige, Slate)
- Full keyboard and screen reader support

PRIVACY

- Zero data collection, no tracking, no ads
- No account required -- everything stays in your browser
- Open source (MIT license)

Part of the LoveSpark suite -- free retro pink tools for neurodivergent minds.
